title: Graph-augmented and Over-smoothing-resistant Contrastive Clustering for Short Text
problem: Augmented samples in contrastive clustering add noise and deep encoders over-smooth fine-grained semantics of short texts.
architecture: GOCC: SBERT embeddings; sentence-level and cluster-level graphs encoded by GCNs to build graph-augmented views; contrastive learning with intermediate-layer PLM representations as negatives (over-smoothing resistance); target-distribution-driven clustering loss; k-means on final embeddings.
key_results: Full GOCC: AgNews ACC 87.68 / NMI 66.12, SearchSnippets 85.27 / 70.73, Tweet 81.84 / 90.35.
Adding the sentence-level graph view improves SearchSnippets accuracy by 7.62% over the variant without graph augmentation.
strengths: Explicitly targets over-smoothing with intermediate-layer negatives.
Ablations for each module and view.

limitations.text: Requires the number of clusters K (k-means initialisation of cluster centres).
Sensitive to temperature and loss-weight hyperparameters (sensitivity analysis shows degradation away from chosen values).
